verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents its own Callback feature: you supply a callback URL and transcription results are POSTed back to it. That is a real outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. However, the evidence only shows a per-request callback for returning transcripts, not a general event-subscription webhook system. missing for 10: registrable event subscriptions beyond per-request transcript callbacks, event types/catalog, signature verification or retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
